latest.title: A numerically flat rank-two bundle without a holomorphic connection on a $\partial\bar\partial$-threefold
latest.abstract: We construct a numerically flat holomorphic vector bundle of rank two on a compact complex threefold satisfying the ordinary $\partial\bar\partial$-lemma and prove that it admits no holomorphic connection, thereby giving,in particular, a negative answer to a question posed by Cao--Deng--Matsumura.
latest.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
latest.workSummary: 构造满足 ddbar 引理的紧复三维空间上数值平坦秩二丛，但不存在全纯联络。
latest.breakthrough: 否定 Kähler 类别中的某些性质可由 ddbar 引理替代的期待。
latest.limitations: 不能把例子误称为 Kähler 底空间上的反例。 研究结论按摘要级分析；未完成正文方法核验。
latest.aiEvidence: AI Declaration 披露模型指出相关已有例子，并参与计算、中间结果核验及写作润色。
latest.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/html/2609.08757v1（AI 声明/致谢；涉及摘要者同时核对元数据）
latest.priorityReason: 复几何正性边界的重要构造。
